intro: bb drives the Bashboard pane it runs in.

commands.name: open
commands.summary: Show a folder in the Files pane, or a file's folder with it selected
commands.details: The path must exist. Relative paths resolve against the folder bb runs in.

commands.name: edit
commands.summary: Open the file in the preferred editor
commands.details: A trailing :<digits> is the line to open at, 1 or more. Folders open too.

commands.name: git
commands.summary: Open the Git pane for this folder's repo
commands.details: Outside a repo it reports "not a git repository".

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Open a Search pane for this folder's repo
commands.details: The query is filled in when given. Outside a repo it searches the current folder.

commands.name: scratch
commands.summary: Open a scratch pad holding the text, or piped standard input
commands.details: Without arguments it reads standard input, up to 1 MiB.

commands.name: term
commands.summary: Open a terminal in this folder or another, optionally running a command
commands.details: The terminal uses the default shell profile. The words after -- are typed into it as one line, followed by Enter, so they follow that shell's syntax.

commands.name: ship
commands.summary: Show this folder's repo in the Ship pane
commands.details: Outside a repo it shows the Overview. Like ports and containers, it shows the existing pane wherever it is or opens a tab of its own, so --collapsed does not apply.

commands.name: ports
commands.details: Shows the existing Ports pane, or opens a Ports tab.

commands.name: containers
commands.details: Shows the existing Containers pane, or opens a Containers tab.

commands.name: auth
commands.summary: Store a Bitbucket API token for the Ship pane
commands.details: Prompts for the token with echo off, or reads it from standard input, and saves it in Windows Credential Manager. --clear removes it. Works outside Bashboard too.

commands.name: auth
commands.summary: Store an Azure DevOps PAT for one organization
commands.details: Prompts for the PAT with echo off, or reads it from standard input, and saves it in Windows Credential Manager under that organization, so each organization needs its own. --clear removes it. Works outside Bashboard too.

commands.name: help
commands.details: bb, bb -h, and bb --help do the same, and work outside Bashboard too.

options.name: --tab
options.summary: Open the new pane alone in a new tab
options.details: Goes anywhere in the command. bb open and bb git then open a new pane even when the current tab has one for the repo. Cannot be combined with --collapsed.

options.summary: End the options; everything after is an argument
options.details: Lets a command, search, or scratch text hold words like --tab. For bb term, the words after it are the command to run.
